categories.name: Platform
categories.description: The hub every app signs in through, plus the pieces that tie the apps together.

categories.name: Media
categories.description: Films, shows, VR videos, music, photos, podcasts, books, retro games and the tools that keep the library tidy.

categories.name: Notes, files and office
categories.description: Notes, voice memos, tasks, calendar, contacts, mail and chat, documents and signatures, files, office documents and your own blog.

categories.name: Money and things
categories.description: Your finances and net worth, invoices, shared costs, the homes you rent out, the car, the house, everything you own, want or have on its way, the cards in your wallet and the dates they run out.

categories.name: Everyday life
categories.description: Your day, your family, habits, health, training and what you eat, your pets, your clothes, places, maps and trails, the weather, sport with friends, cooking, travel, other languages and learning.

categories.name: Work and code
categories.description: Projects, time, clients and deals, forms, tables, a job search, reviews, pull requests, codebases and databases.

categories.name: The server
categories.description: Watch the machines, the web pages you care about and the errors in your apps, reach your computers from anywhere, back them up and know what is on the network.

apps.name: Pocket Core
apps.summary: The hub of your box: one sign-in for every app, one QR code to set up your phone, and apps that work together.

apps.name: Pocket Hub
apps.summary: A personal home page for your box: your apps, today's tasks and meals, quick capture and widgets in one place.

apps.name: Pocket AI
apps.summary: Claude Code and Codex on your own server, from any browser or phone, with approvals and scheduled checks.

apps.name: Pocket Flows
apps.summary: Automations for your server: when something happens, Flows sends a push, adds a task or calls a web address.

apps.name: Pocket Alerts
apps.summary: One inbox for every alert your server and apps send, with only what matters reaching your phone.

apps.name: Pocket Search
apps.summary: Private web search through your own server, with your Pocket apps in the same results.

apps.name: Pocket Watch
apps.summary: Films and shows for the whole household on top of Jellyfin, with a watch history, watchlist and requests.

apps.name: Pocket Music
apps.summary: Your music library for the whole household on top of Navidrome, with daily mixes, lyrics and listening stats.

apps.name: Pocket Photos
apps.summary: Your household's photos in one calm, private app on top of the Immich server you already run.

apps.name: Pocket Podcasts
apps.summary: A podcast server that also turns YouTube channels into podcasts, with your place kept on every device.

apps.name: Pocket Audiobooks
apps.summary: An audiobook library and player for the household, with chapters, bookmarks and your place kept everywhere.

apps.name: Pocket Library
apps.summary: Every ebook, comic and manga you own in one place, with a browser reader and your place synced to KOReader.

apps.name: Pocket Bookshelf
apps.summary: A private reading log: what you read, what you thought of it, the lines worth keeping and what to read next.

apps.name: Pocket Reader
apps.summary: Your feeds and read-later list in one calm place, with highlights, search and sync to your phone's RSS app.

apps.name: Pocket Radio
apps.summary: Internet radio from around the world, plus radio channels made from your own music library.

apps.name: Pocket Requests
apps.summary: Ask for a film, a show or an album and follow it until it is ready to watch or listen to.

apps.name: Pocket Subtitles
apps.summary: Keeps your library's subtitles in sync with the audio, automatically, without ever making a file worse.

apps.name: Pocket Guitar
apps.summary: Your guitar tabs and your practice in one place, with playback, loops, a speed trainer and a practice log.

apps.name: Pocket Notes
apps.summary: Markdown notes kept as plain files where you choose, with search, backlinks, tasks and history.

apps.name: Pocket Voice
apps.summary: Voice memos written out on your own server, tidied up by AI, with the tasks, appointments and spending you mentioned one tap from your other apps.

apps.name: Pocket Tasks
apps.summary: Tasks with areas, lists and smart views, synced to Apple Reminders and other apps over CalDAV.

apps.name: Pocket Boards
apps.summary: Trello-style boards, lists and cards for plans, chores and projects, on your own or shared with your household.

apps.name: Pocket Calendar
apps.summary: A shared calendar for the household that syncs to every phone and pulls in iCloud, Google and Nextcloud.

apps.name: Pocket Contacts
apps.summary: Everyone you know in one searchable place, synced to every phone over CardDAV.

apps.name: Pocket Mail
apps.summary: All your email accounts in one calm inbox, with fast search, snooze, send later and undo send.

apps.name: Pocket Chat
apps.summary: Private chat for your household and friends on your own server: groups, polls, shared to-do lists and cards from your apps, with a catch-up only you see.

apps.name: Pocket Documents
apps.summary: Scans and paper files made searchable, tagged and filed for you. A lighter Paperless-ngx replacement.

apps.name: Pocket Sign
apps.summary: E-signatures on your own server: send a PDF to sign from any phone without an account, or sign one yourself, and get back a sealed PDF with who signed when.

apps.name: Pocket Files
apps.summary: Your files on your own server, with private folders, shares, a WebDAV drive and encrypted links that expire.

apps.name: Pocket Office
apps.summary: Open and edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint files in the browser, wherever they are stored.

apps.name: Pocket Draw
apps.summary: Sketches, text diagrams and detailed diagrams in one place, with history and search.

apps.name: Pocket Clips
apps.summary: Clipboard history, text snippets and search shortcuts on your own server, searchable from every device.

apps.name: Pocket Blog
apps.summary: Your own blog without any programming: pick a look, write in an editor that shows the post as it will read, and publish to fast pages with no trackers.

apps.name: Pocket Money
apps.summary: Personal finance on your own server: quick entry, any currency, bills, budgets and what is safe to spend.

apps.name: Pocket Wealth
apps.summary: Everything you own and owe in one number: accounts, investments with live prices, pension, the flat and the car, minus the mortgage and loans, and how it moves.

apps.name: Pocket Invoicing
apps.summary: Invoices, time tracking and payments for freelancers and one-person businesses, on your own server.

apps.name: Pocket Split
apps.summary: Split costs for trips, flat shares and dinners: who paid what, in any currency, and who owes whom.

apps.name: Pocket Rentals
apps.summary: The homes you rent out in one place: places and units, tenants and leases, rent due, paid and late, deposits, repairs and inspections, and what each place earns.

apps.name: Pocket Garage
apps.summary: Every vehicle on one page: fuel economy, service history, running costs, reminders and documents.

apps.name: Pocket Home
apps.summary: Look after your home: appliances, upkeep that reminds you before it is due, repairs and what they cost, and meter readings.

apps.name: Pocket Renewals
apps.summary: Everything that runs out, in one list: passports, ID cards, insurance, the car's papers, warranties, domains and subscriptions, each with a reminder in time.

apps.name: Pocket Inventory
apps.summary: A home inventory for the household: what you own, how many, where it is and whose it is.

apps.name: Pocket Parcels
apps.summary: Every parcel in one place: where it is, when it arrives, a push when it is out for delivery, and the last day to send it back.

apps.name: Pocket Wallet
apps.summary: Loyalty cards, gift cards, tickets, boarding passes and ID papers on your own server, ready to scan at the till or the gate.

apps.name: Pocket Wishlist
apps.summary: Wishlists and gift ideas that watch prices and stop the family buying the same present twice.

apps.name: Pocket Day
apps.summary: A journal that fills itself in from the other apps on your server, with room for your own words.

apps.name: Pocket Family
apps.summary: The whole household in one place: who picks up the children today, the family's week, chores in turns with stars, shared shopping lists and letters from school read for you.

apps.name: Pocket Habits
apps.summary: A habit tracker based on the one-page bullet-journal spread: a month grid, a few scores and one good thing a day.

apps.name: Pocket Health
apps.summary: Everything your iPhone and watch record about your health, kept on your own server with goals and trends.

apps.name: Pocket Fitness
apps.summary: Your training log: workouts set by set with a rest timer, routines on a weekly plan, personal records and progress per exercise and muscle.

apps.name: Pocket Nutrition
apps.summary: Your food diary: meals with calories, protein, carbs and fat, water, goals worked out for you, barcodes and a meal described in a sentence.

apps.name: Pocket Pets
apps.summary: Look after your pets: each one's papers, vet and food, care that comes back with a reminder, a health log with what it cost, and weight over time.

apps.name: Pocket Wardrobe
apps.summary: Your clothes in one place: what goes with what for your style, today's outfit for the weather and your calendar, the laundry, packing, and what is worth buying.

apps.name: Pocket Movement
apps.summary: Your location history kept at home: where you went, how and how far, and the countries you have visited.

apps.name: Pocket Places
apps.summary: The places you love and the ones you want to try: restaurants, cafés, bars, museums and viewpoints on a list and a map, with every visit and what it cost.

apps.name: Pocket Map
apps.summary: Everything with a place on one map: where you went, your places, trails, trips, photos and payments from your other Pocket apps, each a layer, with your own spots, lines and saved views.

apps.name: Pocket Trails
apps.summary: Plan hikes, walks, runs and rides: routes on a topographic map with the climb and the time, the weather on the day, what to pack, a back-by time that tells someone, and how it went.

apps.name: Pocket Still
apps.summary: Guided breathing and meditation on your own server, with a journal that shows what actually calms you.

apps.name: Pocket Kitchen
apps.summary: Recipes, a weekly meal plan, the shopping list and the pantry in one place on your own server.

apps.name: Pocket Travel
apps.summary: Plan a trip, track what it really costs, and see where you went and what you photographed, on one page.

apps.name: Pocket Translate
apps.summary: Translate text, photos, documents and conversations on your own server, with Pocket AI or an offline engine, and keep a phrasebook, a glossary and your history.

apps.name: Pocket Weather
apps.summary: The weather for your places: now, 48 hours and ten days, air and pollen, warnings with your own limits, advice for your plans and a diary of every day.

apps.name: Pocket League
apps.summary: Sport with friends: a group for each sport you play, the next game planned or voted on, who's in with a waiting list, fair teams, and a table with ratings and form.

apps.name: Pocket Learn
apps.summary: Flashcards with spaced repetition that show each card just before you would forget it.

apps.name: Pocket Horoscope
apps.summary: Birth charts, a daily horoscope and compatibility, worked out from where the planets really are.

apps.name: Pocket Projects
apps.summary: Linear-style issues, boards, projects and roadmaps for a household or a small team.

apps.name: Pocket Time
apps.summary: One timer for everything you do, shared by your Pocket apps, with your whole week in one list.

apps.name: Pocket CRM
apps.summary: Your possible work from the first talk to signed: deals on a board by stage, what each is worth, always a next step, and winning one starts the project and an invoice.

apps.name: Pocket Forms
apps.summary: Forms and surveys anyone can fill in without an account, with one inbox for the answers and one click to turn an answer into a contact, a project, a task or a lead.

apps.name: Pocket Tables
apps.summary: Your own small databases without code, like Airtable on your own server: tables with fields that know what they hold, seen as a grid, a board, a calendar or a gallery.

apps.name: Pocket Jobs
apps.summary: Your job search in one place: jobs on a board from saved to hired, postings read from a link, interviews in your calendar, offers side by side and how the search goes.

apps.name: Pocket Review
apps.summary: Review a PDF together with pinned comments, tracked issues, a strict sign-off and a report of who read what.

apps.name: Pocket PR Review
apps.summary: Read a pull request as a story, in the order the change makes sense, with one sentence per file.

apps.name: Pocket Blueprint
apps.summary: See how any codebase is built: its structure, who uses what, and every endpoint, table and setting.

apps.name: Pocket Database
apps.summary: Browse, query and safely edit every PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis and SQLite database on your server.

apps.name: Pocket Monitoring
apps.summary: Watch your server and other machines live, with a year of history and phone alerts when something goes wrong.

apps.name: Pocket Lookout
apps.summary: Watches web pages for you and says, in one sentence, what changed and whether it matters.

apps.name: Pocket Errors
apps.summary: Error tracking for your apps and websites on your own server: what broke, where in the code, how often and since which release. Any Sentry SDK sends to it unchanged.

apps.name: Pocket Games
apps.summary: Your retro game library: play in the browser, saves that follow you, and RomM apps on your handheld.

apps.name: Pocket Sphere
apps.summary: Your video library with a VR player in the browser, previews, lookups that name your files, and downloads from a link.

apps.name: Pocket Backups
apps.summary: Back up the whole server, copy it off-site, and get a plain answer to whether everything is safe.

apps.name: Pocket Network
apps.summary: Every device on your home network in one readable list, with alerts when something new joins.

apps.name: Pocket Remote
apps.summary: Your own computers from a phone or a browser: a Mac, a Windows PC or a Linux terminal over your tailnet, with Wake-on-LAN, file transfers and a log of every session.

native.name: Pocket Launcher
native.summary: A Raycast-style launcher for the Mac: your apps, every Pocket app, Pocket AI, tasks, money and dictation behind one shortcut.

native.name: Pocket Studio
native.summary: A small DAW for the Mac: record, edit and mix, then play along with the tabs in Pocket Guitar.

native.name: Pocket Files for iPhone and Mac
native.summary: Your server's files in Finder and in the Files app, through Apple's File Provider. The Nextcloud client replacement.

native.name: Pocket AI for iPhone
native.summary: Claude Code and Codex on your server, from your phone: live threads, approvals, forks, worktrees and schedules.

native.name: Pocket Voice for iPhone
native.summary: A recorder that never loses a memo: record on the phone, your server writes it out and finds the tasks, events and spending.

native.name: Pocket Bookshelf for iPhone
native.summary: What you are reading and where you are in it, your library, thoughts and quotes, and a Pocket AI chat for every book.

native.name: Pocket Remote for iPhone
native.summary: Your Mac's screen, a Windows PC or a Linux terminal over your tailnet, from the phone, with a real keyboard around it.

native.name: Pocket Sphere for iPhone
native.summary: Your video library on the phone, and VR videos on a flat screen: look around, one eye, or a phone headset.
